title: the Old Mill House Rising Revisited
author: Ada Nystrom
blurb: Lena Voss, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
